answer: Sybil resistance via stake-weighted reputation slot attestation: each agent must lock a bond to register, and peers randomly challenge it to prove unique control of a hardware key. A sybil farm cannot cheaply echo a single key across many identities, since each duplicate fails the challenge and forfeits its bond. Honest agents mirror their bond history on-chain, letting peers verify lineage, while attackers who forge fake attestations lose their stake and reputation.
